semantics: executed-fit lineage identity; not a persisted trained-model artifact registry

identity_layers.partition_spec_id: SHA-256 of the governed train/test partition specification for the split seed
identity_layers.preprocessing_spec_id: SHA-256 of the frozen preprocessing specification
identity_layers.model_spec_id: SHA-256 of estimator class plus effective hyperparameters; stochastic random_state is replaced by the declared model seed
identity_layers.training_spec_id: SHA-256 binding dataset/design identity, partition specification, preprocessing specification, model specification, and declared model seed
identity_layers.execution_spec_id: SHA-256 binding training specification to experiment family, config, observed environment, and execution policy
identity_layers.fit_evidence_id: SHA-256 binding the execution specification to the complete committed result row and family-manifest identity

canonicalisation: UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and separators=(',', ':')
notes: The frozen study persists behavioural, score-diagnostic, and metric evidence for each fit, not estimator binaries.
Code identity is represented by the frozen design-lock digest rather than a retroactively added Git commit field.
A repeated training specification may appear in more than one experimental family; execution_spec_id includes the experiment family so those executions remain distinguishable.
